title: Hurricane Ian: wind, then water

link.method: Pearson r, ERA5 hourly wind speed at Fort Myers vs CO-OPS Fort Myers hourly water level above MHHW, partner lagged 0..12 h (tide not removed)

residual.method: same, partner = surge residual (observed minus CO-OPS tide prediction)

link.note: r keeps rising up to the 12 h edge: no clear optimum lag. The window correlation is driven by the slow shape (wind high for a day before landfall, water high for a day after). Peak to peak timing is given separately.

gaps: Naples gauge stopped reporting at 28 Sep 17:06 UTC at 1.89 m above MHHW during the surge; the gap after that is kept empty, never bridged.
ERA5 is a reanalysis model at about 31 km: it smooths the eyewall, so its Fort Myers wind and pressure are far weaker than the measured storm (best track minimum is given for comparison).
ERA5 point = grid cell 26.75N -81.75E nearest the Fort Myers gauge.
Water levels are 6 minute CO-OPS readings averaged to the hour; an hour with fewer than 6 of 10 readings stays empty (null).
Datum MHHW (mean higher high water) per gauge: values above 0 are above the normal daily high tide.
Fort Myers 8725520 recorded the whole event (no gap); it is the hero partner gauge.
Track: IBTrACS 3-hourly positions; points between the 6-hourly best track fixes are interpolated by IBTrACS (flag interpolated = true).
IMERG V07B Final run half-hourly rain is a satellite estimate (observed, merged microwave and infrared); grid shown at 0.2 deg, 3 hour means.
The wind to water level link includes the tide; the residual link (observed minus tide prediction) is given too.
ERA5 wind and pressure grids are sampled every 0.5 deg from the 0.25 deg ERA5 grid.

hero_norm.method: ERA5 hourly 10 m wind speed at the Fort Myers grid cell, 23 Sep to 1 Oct of 2017 to 2021 (all hours pooled)

sources.name: ERA5 hourly 10 m wind and surface pressure
sources.producer: ECMWF Copernicus C3S, served by Open-Meteo
sources.baseline: Fort Myers wind 23 Sep to 1 Oct, 2017 to 2021

sources.name: CO-OPS water level and tide predictions
sources.baseline: datum MHHW; predictions used for the surge residual
